title: Reseller trial & SKU onboarding cheatsheet
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact cheat sheet for working with channel/reseller partners to get Redwood Inference listed in cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) when the partner will resell our SKU, run trials for their customers, and act as the front-line commercial relationship. The doc combines: (a) SKU and trial flow recommendations, (b) minimal technical & legal gates for listing, (c) marketing copy variants for marketplace tiles, and (d) quick comms scripts for partner ops.

Context and intended audience:
- Audience: partner managers, channel ops, partner engineering, legal touchpoints.
- When to use: early onboarding with a reseller, pre-marketplace listing sprint, and as a checklist for product/engineering entitlements.
- Not a replacement for the full Marketplace Playbook — this is a one-page operational cheat for fast launches.

Executive summary:
- Recommended approach: Bundle a single predictable SKU for resellers that maps to Hosted API units + optional Dedicated add-on. Offer a 14-day metered trial with free credit and automated provisioning. Provide three tile copy variants (concise, technical, customer-outcome) so partner marketing can choose. Set two core technical gates: SSO/provisioning and metering/reporting integration.

Key goals for partner-first listing:
- Keep SKU mapping simple: 1 public SKU = hosted usage; 1 optional SKU = dedicated/reserved capacity add-on.
- Trial must be low-friction: programmatic activation, SKU-level tracking, auto-expire after trial period.
- Billing clarity: reseller handles invoice to end-customer; Redwood provides metered usage reports and monthly statements to reseller.

SKU design recommendations (minimum viable):
- SKU: REDWOOD-HOSTED-API-UNIT
  - Unit definition: 1 API unit = 1000 generated tokens (or use partner-accepted token definition).
  - Price guidance: map to public list price with reseller margin band (discuss with partner finance).
- Add-on SKU: REDWOOD-DEDICATED-POOL (optional)
  - For customers requiring reserved capacity. Price as monthly commit.
- Trial SKU: REDWOOD-TRIAL-CREDIT
  - Function: provides X free credits for 14 days, automatically consumed by REDWOOD-HOSTED-API-UNIT.

Trial flow (recommended):
1) Partner signs customer into reseller portal -> partner passes reseller_customer_id + email to Redwood launch endpoint.
2) Redwood provisions trial credits under partner-managed account and returns credentials (API key scoped to trial).
3) Trial is meterable: tokens consumed reduce trial credit balance; events are exported to partner metering endpoint and Redwood billing ledger.
4) 13 days in: automated email to partner + end-customer with upgrade CTA and estimated monthly run-rate based on usage.
5) Day 15: trial auto-expire, API keys revert to read-only with clear upgrade path.

Minimal technical requirements (preflight checklist):
- Provisioning and entitlement:
  - API: programmatic trial provisioning endpoint (POST /partner/v1/trials) - documented request fields.
  - Account linkback: ability to map partner_customer_id -> Redwood account id.
  - API key lifecycle: create, expire, upgrade token flow.
- Metering & reporting:
  - Event export: daily usage CSV or webhook (preferred) to partner endpoint with token counts and model used.
  - SKU mapping: usage rows must include SKU id, timestamp, token_count, model_version.
- Security & SSO:
  - Optional: SAML or OIDC for admin access on Dedicated onboarding flows.
  - KMS: for Private deployments, reseller must confirm KMS integration for customer where required.
- Compliance: SOC2/ISO summary provided in listing assets; partner legal requires a short data-handling FAQ.

Marketplace listing copy variants (tile + one-line + 3-line) — three distinct tones so partner marketing can pick: 
1) Concise (GTM-friendly)
  - Tile title: Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference
  - One-liner: Fast, predictable LLM inference with cost controls and SLA-backed capacity.
  - 3-line: Deliver production-grade text, chat, and embeddings across hosted and dedicated deployments. Built-in caching, batching, and routing keep latency low and unit-costs predictable.

2) Technical (platform/engineer-first)
  - Tile title: Redwood Inference — Optimized inference runtime
  - One-liner: GPU-optimized serving, KV-cache-aware batching, and model-aware kernel selection.
  - 3-line: Run high-throughput LLM workloads with deterministic latency. Supports quantized models, autoscaling dedicated pools, and programmatic rollouts. Ideal for engineering teams requiring observability and fine-grained cost controls.

3) Outcomes (business buyer)
  - Tile title: Production LLMs with enterprise SLAs
  - One-liner: Reduce inference cost while improving response times for end-user features.
  - 3-line: Redwood helps product teams ship LLM features faster with predictable costs, fallback policies, and secure private deployments. Includes controls for rollout, monitoring, and model quality alerts.

Pre-listing content & assets (required):
- Short product description (100–300 words) — pick one of the variants above and expand with 3 bullets of differentiators.
- 3 screenshots: Console usage, per-route latency chart, and SKU/usage billing sample.
- Security/compliance FAQ (2 pages max).
- Billing contact and MSA link for reseller.

Partner ops playbook (quick runbook):
- Day 0: Legal accepts reseller MSA + SKU price bands -> ops creates partner account in Redwood Portal.
- Day 1: Tech spike: test trial provisioning with sandbox partner_customer_id.
- Day 2: Upload listing assets to marketplace preview; validate tile copy and screenshots.
- Pre-launch: run 5 internal smoke trials and confirm metering webhook deliveries for 7 days.
- Launch: Enable live listing and monitor first-30-day usage to tune SKU pricing / trial entitlements.

Common risks & mitigation notes:
- Risk: Trial abuse (scripts/spam) -> Mitigate: rate-limit trial provisioning per partner_customer_id and require partner contact for bulk activations.
- Risk: Metering mismatch -> Mitigate: daily reconciliation file + webhook checksum + partner webhook replay window.
- Risk: Customer confusion on who bills -> Mitigate: listing copy must state reseller invoices end customers and include partner support contact.

Example marketplace messaging snippets (for partner marketing):
- Social post: "Now available: Redwood Inference on [Cloud Marketplace]. Quick 14-day trial with partner-managed billing. Ship LLM features faster with guaranteed latency SLAs. Learn more: <link>"
- Support canned response: "Thanks for trying Redwood via our marketplace offer. Your trial runs until {expiry_date}. To upgrade, visit {partner_portal_link} or contact your account rep."

Next steps & owners (recommended sprint):
- PartnerOps: finalize reseller margin band and MSA (owner: Diego Rivera) - due EOD +7 days.
- PartnerEngineering: implement trial provisioning endpoint + webhook (owner: Maya Thompson) - prototype +10 days.
- GTM Content: pick tile copy variant and prepare screenshots (owner: Jonah Li) - +5 days.
- Legal: draft short data-handling FAQ for listing (owner: Priya S.) - +12 days.

Notes / open questions for partner kickoff:
- Should trial length be 14 or 30 days for this partner segment? (tradeoff: longer reduces conversion velocity; shorter reduces trial signal.)
- Do resellers require consolidated monthly invoices or per-customer pass-through?
- Can partner accept webhooks or do they prefer daily CSV drops?

Appendix: short sample API payloads (for engineering)
- Provision trial (POST /partner/v1/trials):
  {"partner_customer_id": "string",
   "customer_email": "string",
   "trial_sku": "REDWOOD-TRIAL-CREDIT",
   "start_ts": "2025-11-02T00:00:00Z"
  }
- Metering webhook (POST to partner):
  [ { "sku": "REDWOOD-HOSTED-API-UNIT", "tokens": 4320, "model": "rw-gpt-13b", "timestamp": "2025-11-02T04:00:00Z" } ]

If useful, I can convert this into a one-slide preview for partner kickoff or expand the sample legal FAQ language.
